faq.q: Where and what is OmShakthy Industrial Park?
faq.a: OmShakthy Industrial Park is Chennai's first and only private industry park, offering 53 industrial plots across 8.10 acres, ranging from 2327 Sq.ft to 5980 Sq.ft — designed for SMEs, IT companies, warehouses, manufacturers, distributors, cloud kitchens and BPOs.

faq.q: How connected is OmShakthy Industrial Park?
faq.a: OmShakthy Industrial Park sits just 1 minute from the Outer Ring Road (ORR), 10 minutes from the airport, and 15 minutes from Tambaram Railway Station and Guindy, with the upcoming major District Road (MD1163) nearby — giving businesses fast access to key logistics and transport corridors.

faq.q: What is the price for an industrial plot at OmShakthy Industrial Park?
faq.a: Pricing for OmShakthy Industrial Park's 53 plots (2327 Sq.ft to 5980 Sq.ft, across 8.10 acres) is currently on request — contact our team or book a free site visit for the latest rates.

faq.q: What are the advantages of investing in OmShakthy Industrial Park?
faq.a: Plots at OmShakthy Industrial Park offer potential for high rentals, price appreciation, seamless connectivity to key destinations, and hassle-free financing — a launchpad for businesses from SMEs to IT giants, warehouses, manufacturers, distributors, cloud kitchens and BPOs.

faq.q: How do I Book my Plot at OmShakthy Industrial Park?
faq.a: To book a plot at OmShakthy Industrial Park, you can schedule a free site visit through this page. Our executive will walk you through plot availability, sizes and pricing for this private industry park.
